actionSequence.action: Continue Apple Developer Organization enrollment for 深圳市闪现生活科技有限公司 after D-U-N-S is delivered.
actionSequence.boundary: Enter the D-U-N-S number only on Apple pages; do not store it in the repository.

actionSequence.action: Confirm the Apple Developer Team ID shown on the organization page.
actionSequence.boundary: L2TYJNDTJK may only be reused when Apple confirms the same Team ID.

actionSequence.action: Confirm the current Apple ID has Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles, App management, build upload, TestFlight management, and submit-review permissions.
actionSequence.boundary: Do not continue to certificates, Archive, TestFlight, or Submit for Review if any required role is missing.

actionSequence.action: Verify com.mewpow.xiaonaiping, group.com.mewpow.xiaonaiping.shared, and Associated Domains applinks:api.mewpow.com under the confirmed Team ID.
actionSequence.boundary: The bundle and capability page does not replace WeChat Open Platform, SMS, OBS, filing, or iOS 26.5 real-device evidence.

actionSequence.action: If the Apple Team ID differs from L2TYJNDTJK, update project signing, ExportOptions teamID=<confirmed Apple Developer Team ID>, AASA appID/appIDs, and WeChat Universal Link evidence.
actionSequence.boundary: Do not use an old Team ID Archive or TestFlight build as submission evidence.

actionSequence.action: Inject real XNP_WECHAT_APP_ID, XNP_WECHAT_URL_SCHEME, and XNP_WECHAT_UNIVERSAL_LINK into Release configuration.
actionSequence.boundary: Placeholder wx... values and debug WeChat values cannot pass Release or bundle gates; do not put XNP_WECHAT_APP_SECRET in /tmp/xnp-wechat-release.env.

actionSequence.action: Create or select App Store Distribution certificate and provisioning profiles for com.mewpow.xiaonaiping and com.mewpow.xiaonaiping.widgets under the confirmed Team ID.
actionSequence.boundary: Do not commit certificate private keys, downloaded provisioning profile files, or signing secrets.

actionSequence.action: Run the Release archive command for generic iOS using /tmp/XiaoNaiPing-CN.xcarchive after sourcing /tmp/xnp-wechat-release.env.
actionSequence.command: . /tmp/xnp-wechat-release.env && xcodebuild -project App/iOS/XiaoNaiPing.xcodeproj -scheme XiaoNaiPing -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -archivePath /tmp/XiaoNaiPing-CN.xcarchive XNP_WECHAT_APP_ID="$XNP_WECHAT_APP_ID" XNP_WECHAT_URL_SCHEME="$XNP_WECHAT_URL_SCHEME" XNP_WECHAT_UNIVERSAL_LINK="$XNP_WECHAT_UNIVERSAL_LINK" archive
actionSequence.boundary: Archive success does not replace TestFlight processing or iOS 26.5 real-device regression.

actionSequence.action: Run xcodebuild -exportArchive with Docs/08_Release/XCODE_EXPORT_OPTIONS_APP_STORE_CONNECT.plist using method=app-store-connect, destination=upload, teamID=<confirmed Apple Developer Team ID>, and testFlightInternalTestingOnly=false.
actionSequence.boundary: Do not commit the exported .ipa or App Store Connect API keys.

actionSequence.action: Wait until the App Store Connect TestFlight build is processed and testable.
actionSequence.boundary: A build upload receipt is not enough; the TestFlight page must show the processed/testable state.

actionSequence.action: Rerun post-archive and post-upload gates against the same exported app or TestFlight build.
actionSequence.boundary: Do not mix proofs from another build, another Team ID, simulator output, or iOS 27.

actionSequence.action: Run RD-01 到 RD-24 on iOS 26.5 TestFlight or an iOS 26.5 signed real-device build.
actionSequence.boundary: Simulator, iOS 27, or a different build cannot replace the iOS 26.5 regression.

actionSequence.action: Archive 05-signed-archive.png, 06-testflight.png, 12-real-device-regression.md, and same-round App Store evidence after gates pass.
actionSequence.boundary: Do not claim Submit for Review readiness until app-store-evidence, production-readiness, and launch-objective-audit are ready.
